overview.core_loop: Build a colony, stabilize survival resources, reinvest production, unlock new systems, and return for harder objectives.
overview.unique_selling_point: A compact colony survival loop with production chains, crisis pressure, and repeatable meta progression.
overview.year_2_role: Core strategy game for players who want deeper structure than a casual idle game.

core_mechanics.name: Colony construction
core_mechanics.description: Build production, infrastructure, research, defense, and special facilities.

core_mechanics.name: Resource production chains
core_mechanics.description: Convert basic resources into advanced materials through chained buildings.

core_mechanics.name: Survival management
core_mechanics.description: Manage oxygen, food, water, energy, population, and crisis thresholds.

core_mechanics.name: Offline production
core_mechanics.description: Award capped production while the player is away.

core_mechanics.name: Planet exploration
core_mechanics.description: Unlock planets with different resource profiles, hazards, and milestones.

core_mechanics.name: Research tree
core_mechanics.description: Spend research points to unlock buildings, automation, and survival tools.

core_mechanics.name: Disaster response
core_mechanics.description: React to meteor showers, storms, outages, and disease events.

progression.description: Players move from a starting colony into higher-difficulty planets with broader resource chains.

technical.save_system: Local save first, cloud save later
